u0: The key has not been picked up yet and the door is still closed. The agent must locate the yellow key on the starting side of the wall and move to it, then pick it up; picking it up transitions to the has-key state.
u1: The agent is carrying the yellow key but the door is still closed. It must navigate to the yellow door and toggle it open; a successful toggle transitions to the door-open state.
u2: The door is open, whether or not the key is still carried. The agent must pass through the doorway and navigate to the green goal in the bottom-right corner; stepping onto the goal cell ends the episode and transitions to the final state.
u3: Terminal success state: the agent has reached the goal after opening the door with the key. The episode is complete and no further steps are taken.
